# Need support?

#### Try the documentation

We have documentation available for all things WildBeast at [wildbeast.guide](https://wildbeast.guide/)

#### Ask in Discussions

Questions about self-hosting or developing WildBeast are welcome in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/TheSharks/WildBeast/discussions/categories/q-a).

#### Join our Discord

Want more direct support? Join our Discord server.

[![Discord](https://discord.com/api/guilds/110462143152803840/widget.png?style=banner4)](https://discord.gg/wildbot)

#### Found a bug or a security issue?

Open an [issue](https://github.com/TheSharks/WildBeast/issues/new/choose) for bugs. Report security issues privately, as described in our [security policy](https://github.com/TheSharks/WildBeast/security/policy).
